How the model works

  • Who's in. PuckPedia's Group 6 tracker lists, goalies removed: 47 skaters for the 2027 class and 45 who reached Group 6 in 2026. Thirteen players appear in both (they re-signed one-year deals and are on track to qualify again).
  • Games. Every NHL and AHL regular-season game since October 2023, from NHL.com and the AHL's official stats feed. KHL, SHL and other European games are not in the trends.
  • Rates. Goals, assists and +/- per game. For goals and assists, AHL games count at 0.45 of an NHL game so a call-up isn't penalized for tougher competition. +/- is not converted.
  • Steadying small samples. Each month, quarter or season is blended with the player's prior two-season rate (6, 10 and 15 games of weight), so a three-game October can't top the board.
  • Trends. A weighted line through the last 6 active months (3+ GP), the last 4 calendar quarters (8+ GP), and each season (10+ GP). The slope is the trend.
  • Score. Each of the nine slopes becomes a z-score against the same class and position, capped at ±3, then weighted. The balanced default puts goals and assists at 40% each and +/- at 20% (it's the noisiest of the three), with monthly 30%, quarterly 30%, yearly 40%. Use the Weighting menu to change the emphasis.
  • Caution. A high trend score means a player is improving, not that he is the best player. Read it next to the production axis in the scatter chart. Players flagged "small sample" have fewer than 60 games or a window with too little data.

One-to-one board

If every trending Group 6 player went to exactly one team: each goes to the open slot where his fit (upgrade + half his trend score) is highest, and each slot gets one player.

How team fits work

  • Still on the team. Only players on each club's current NHL roster count. Anyone traded, waived or sent down is out.
  • Depth. Forwards and defensemen are ranked by average ice time this season (last season's if they've played under 3 games). Extras beyond 12 forwards and 6 defensemen are left out.
  • Weakness. Goals, assists and +/- per game over 2025-26 plus 2026-27, steadied toward the league bottom-six/bottom-four average with 10 games of weight, then compared with every NHL player in the same role.
  • Young players. Players 22 and under are tagged "developing": their numbers may be low, but a team is unlikely to replace them.
  • Fills. Only 2027 Group 6 players with a positive trend score, at the same position (C, LW, RW, LD, RD), whose projected score beats the incumbent's. AHL-heavy projections carry more uncertainty than NHL numbers, so read "Upgrade" as a ranking, not a promise.
Data through Nov 17, 2026. Official statistics provided by the American Hockey League (leaguestat.com) and NHL.com. Group 6 eligibility lists from the PuckPedia Group 6 UFA Tracker.
